sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Mummineni Sudheer Kumar
 Writ Petition No.288 of 2023
Order:

This Writ Petition is filed seeking to grant the following relief:
"... to issue a writ, order or direction, more particularly one in the nature of WRIT OF MANDAMUS declaring the inaction on the part of the respondent authorities in considering the issue of fresh passport application vide File No.HY2064903593922,
dated 24.12.2022, submitted by the petitioner without reference to the Criminal Case i.e., C.C..No.831/2022 before the Hon'ble Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate at Siricilla, Rajanna Siricilla District, as illegal, arbitrary unconstitutional, contrary to law and against the principals of natural justice and consequently direct the respondent authorities to consider the issue of fresh passport renewal application vide File No.HY2064903593922, dated 24.12.2022, submitted by the petitioner without reference to the Criminal Case i.e., C.C.No.831/2022 before the Honble Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate at Siricilla, Rajanna Siricilla District and pass such other order or orders as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the circumstances of the case."

entities.text: Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate at Siricilla, Rajanna Siricilla District
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate at Siricilla, Rajanna Siricilla District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Gadi Praveen Kumar, learned Deputy Solicitor General of India, appearing for the respondents.
3.

It is the case of the petitioner that he made application No.HY2064903593922, dated 24.12.2022,
for issuance of fresh passport.

The respondents, while taking steps for issuance of fresh passport to the petitioner, came to know about the pendency of a criminal case in C.C.No.831 of 2022 pending on the file of the Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate at Sircilla, for the offences under Sections 420 and 406 of I.P.C.

entities.text: Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate at Sircilla
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In view of pendency of the said criminal case, respondent No.2 kept the application of the petitioner pending for issuance of fresh passport.
Aggrieved by such action of respondent No.2, the petitioner approached this Court by filing the present writ petition.

4. Sri Gadi Praveen Kumar, learned Deputy Solicitor General of India, appearing for the respondents, submitted that the issuance of fresh passport cannot be granted to the applicant, in case, if any criminal case is pending against the said applicant.

He further submitted that said issue is dealt with by the learned Single Judge of this Court in the case of Pervez Mohammad Abdul v.
Union of India and another1 and the issue of renewal of the passport be governed by the very same judgment. 2023(1) ALD 394 (TS)
6.

entities.text:
Pervez Mohammad Abdul v.
Union of India and another1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the petitioner, contended that renewal of the passport is different from issuance of fresh passport.

Rajesh Chaitanya Beemuni vs The Govt. Of India on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191283918/
1 7.

entities.text: Rajesh Chaitanya Beemuni vs The Govt. Of India on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This Court, having considered the submissions made on either side and after perusing the material on record including the judgment in Pervez Mohammad Abdul (supra), is of the considered view that in the light of Section 6 of the Act, 1967, the issuance of fresh passport is also governed by the very same provisions and restrictions as are applicable for issuing a fresh or renewal of the passport.
Admittedly, a criminal case is pending against the petitioner herein before the competent Court.

Therefore, this Court is of the considered view that the application of the petitioner can be directed to be considered by imposing restrictions and conditions as were imposed in the case of Pervez Mohammad Abdul.
8.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall also stand closed.
There shall be no order as to costs.
